messages:
Emma: Quick heads-up — opening a docs PR to reorganize the Capacity Handbook SLA examples into a matrix and drop a short SDK snippet for autoscale usage. Need a quick review/edits before I merge.
Raj: Nice. Which matrix columns are you thinking? tenant type, SLA class, preemption risk, and recommended scale_policy?
Emma: Exactly. Also want an 'isolation notes' column for preemption/eviction behavior. Will add a short YAML + Python SDK example.
Marta: One note: isolation wording in current handbook is ambiguous. We should be explicit about 'soft-isolation' vs 'hard-isolation' and how it maps to eviction windows.
Sam: Can you paste the SDK snippet here? I can test locally.
Emma: dropping snippet below — still rough:

```
# Python SDK example: reserve + autoscale policy
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
resp = c.create_capacity(reservation_name='prod-frontend', gpus=4, scale_policy={
  'target_rps': 2000,
  'cooldown_s': 300,
})
print(resp)
```

Raj: Looks fine. Maybe use `scale_policy: {'min_instances':1, 'max_instances':8, 'scale_step':1}` to be clearer.
Marta: Also call out latency SLOs. For example matrix row for 'SLA: Gold' -> 99.9% p99 < 200ms, recommend reserved pool + soft isolation.
Emma: good point. I'll add a small note linking to the runtime docs for p99 measurement.
Sam: Regarding the reorg — do we need to update the handbook TOC and the nav alias? Last time links broke.
Emma: yes — I'll add redirects. Which page should be the canonical anchor? thinking `/capacity/handbook/sla-examples` -> rename to `/capacity/handbook/sla-matrix`.
Raj: If you rename, update the SDK snippet doc reference in the API surface doc too (it's referenced from README). Search for `/capacity/handbook/sla-examples` across repo.
Emma: will do `rg '/capacity/handbook/sla-examples' -n` and push fixes in the PR.
docs-bot: checklist: [x] PR opened, [ ] tests, [ ] link redirects, [ ] examples vetted
Marta: A tiny editorial nit — avoid 'eviction' as catch-all; we should say 'preemption/termination' depending on provider.
Emma: agreed. I'll revise language to 'preemption (eviction/termination) window — X mins'.
Sam: I can run the snippet against staging. Ping me when PR is up.
Emma: PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — reviewers: @Raj @Marta @Sam
Raj: Reviewing now.
Marta: scanning. Quick note: add a one-line callout about isolation metrics (P95 latency while scaling) and link to observability dashboard.
Emma: added callout and dashboard link. Also adjusted matrix CSV export example.
Sam: tested snippet; needs credentials env var example. Suggest adding `REDWOOD_API_KEY` note.
Emma: added env var line and small `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` example.
Raj: LGTM aside from one tiny casing nit.
Emma: merging in 30 if no objections. :thumbsup:
Marta: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
